free_tier_limits: Public SODA 2.1 reads are free. Anonymous requests use a lower shared IP-based pool; app-token requests have no fixed cap and are throttled only for abusive or malicious use. No numeric anonymous threshold is published.
rate_limits: Anonymous requests may be throttled mainly by source IP. App-token requests are currently unthrottled unless abusive or malicious. Throttling returns HTTP 429; no numeric threshold is published.
resolution_notes: auth_type=none: anonymous SODA 2.1 reads are allowed; tokens are optional identification (https://dev.socrata.com/docs/app-tokens.html). free_tier_limits: no numeric cap; shared-IP and token policies are documented at https://dev.socrata.com/docs/app-tokens.html. rate_limits: the same source documents 429 and abuse throttling. cors=yes: public read-only CORS is supported (https://dev.socrata.com/docs/cors-and-jsonp.html). example: corrected to current fields from https://data.seattle.gov/resource/tazs-3rd5.json.
